question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Out of the blue
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Completely unexpected)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Out of the blue"** refers to something that happens suddenly and without any prior warning or indication. (अचानक और अप्रत्याशित रूप से होने वाला)

 
 
• **Example:** The news of her promotion came out of the blue and left everyone surprised.
 
 
 
• **Completely unexpected** refers to something that was not anticipated or foreseen in any way. (पूरी तरह से अप्रत्याशित)
 
 
• **Example:** The sudden rainfall in the middle of the desert was completely unexpected for the tourists.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Completely unexpected)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Quite old** (काफी पुराना): Something that has existed for a long time.

 
 
• **Example:** The building is quite old and needs renovation.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Extremely cold** (बेहद ठंडा): Refers to something that is very low in temperature.
 
 
• **Example:** The weather in Antarctica is extremely cold all year round.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Very doubtful** (बहुत संदिग्ध): Something that is uncertain or questionable.
 
 
• **Example:** His explanation for being late sounded very doubtful to the teacher.

The correct answer is '**highly**'.
